question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Armed to the teeth

options.text: Safeguard oneself in every possible way
To have no weapon to fight

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e.** 'Fully armed, having many weapons'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **alternative** that best expresses the meaning of the idiom "Armed to the teeth" is **option 4) **Fully armed, having many weapons.(पूरी तरह सशस्त्र धारी होना, कई हथियारों से लैस होना)
 
• Explanation of **other options:**
 
 
• **Safeguard oneself in every possible way**: हर संभव तरीके से अपनी सुरक्षा करना
 
• **To have no weapon to fight**: कोई हथियार नहीं होना
 
• **Different attacking techniques:** विभिन्न हमला करने की तकनीकें
 
 

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: *'Fully armed, having many weapons'.*
